description.zh: 待查看表或视图的所属项目名称。
description.en: The name of the project to which the table or view belongs.

description.zh: 待查看表或视图的所属Schema名称。
description.en: The name of the schema to which the table or view belongs.

description.zh: 待查看表或视图的名称。
description.en: The name of the table or view that you want to view.

description.zh:
待查看表或视图的类型。取值：
- **internal**：内部表。
- **external**：外部表。
- **view**：视图。
- **materializedView**：<props="china">[物化视图](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">[物化视图](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>。
description.en:
The type of the table or view that you want to view. Valid values:

- **internal**: internal table

- **external**: external table

- **view**: view

- **materializedView**: [materialize view](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute get-table-info --project-name odps_project --schema-name default --table-name sale_detail --type internal --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/projects/odps_project/tables/sale_detail --region cn-hangzhou --schemaName default --type internal --header "Content-Type=application/json"
